title: Strategi Membaca dan Bentuk Soal TKA
summary: Mastering English reading comprehension for TKA: understanding CEFR A2/B1 text parameters, question taxonomy (explicit, implicit, evaluative), and tactical skimming-scanning techniques.

lessons.title: Assessment Blueprint: CEFR Levels A2–B1 and Text Characteristics

blocks.html: Assessment Blueprint: CEFR Levels A2–B1 and Text Characteristics: Comprehending text length, high-frequency vocabulary thresholds, and syntactic structures tested in TKA.

blocks.title: Bentuk soal TKA
blocks.html:
• PG (pilihan ganda): pilih satu jawaban benar dari lima pilihan.
  • PGK MCMA (multiple choice multiple answer): jawaban benar lebih dari satu. Instruksinya: There is more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer!
  • PGK Kategori: setiap pernyataan dinilai masuk kategori mana, misalnya Yes/No, True/False, Similarity/Difference, atau Preparation/Breaks.

blocks.title: Contoh soal MCMA
blocks.question:
Text: "The museum is open from Tuesday to Sunday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Entry is free for students with a student card. Photos are allowed, but flash is not."

Which statements are true? (1) Students with a card pay nothing. (2) The museum opens on Mondays. (3) Visitors may take photos without flash.
steps: Nilai setiap pernyataan terpisah, jangan menebak dari kombinasi.
(1) benar: Entry is free for students with a student card.

blocks.question: A question asks: What is the writer's purpose in writing the text? Which competency level does it test?
blocks.hint: Apakah tujuan penulis biasanya ditulis langsung?
blocks.explanation: Tujuan penulisan jarang dinyatakan eksplisit, jadi harus disimpulkan dari isi teks: pemahaman inferensial.

blocks.title: Level kompetensi dan fakta atau opini
blocks.caption: Kelompokkan setiap pertanyaan menurut level kompetensinya, lalu coba set kedua untuk membedakan fakta dan opini. Tekan Check untuk melihat penjelasan.

blocks.title: Contoh: makna kata dari konteks
blocks.question: "The new bridge is very sturdy. Even heavy trucks can cross it safely during floods." The word sturdy means ....
steps: Kalimat berikutnya menjelaskan: truk berat pun aman melintas saat banjir.
Jadi jembatan itu kuat dan kokoh.

blocks.question: Which option is the best paraphrase of The shop is closed on public holidays?

options.A: The shop opens every day of the year.
options.B: The shop does not open on national holidays.
options.C: The shop closes early on Fridays.
options.D: The shop is open only during holidays.

blocks.hint: Cari makna yang sama dengan kata berbeda.
blocks.explanation: closed on public holidays = tidak buka pada hari libur nasional.

lessons.title: Targeted Reading: Topic Sentences vs Supporting Evidence

blocks.html: Targeted Reading: Topic Sentences vs Supporting Evidence: Locating main ideas in opening/closing sentences and rapidly identifying dates, names, and metrics.

blocks.title: Contoh: rujukan kata ganti
blocks.question: "Rina lent her laptop to Dodi because his was broken. He returned it the next morning." What do his and it refer to?
steps: his adalah kata ganti milik laki-laki: Dodi. his = his laptop (laptop Dodi).
it adalah benda yang dikembalikan Dodi: laptop milik Rina.
blocks.answer: his = Dodi's laptop; it = Rina's laptop

blocks.title: Muatan teks
blocks.html:
• Jenis teks: descriptive, recount, narrative, procedure, dan analytical exposition.
  • Konteks: sehari-hari, tempat kerja (vokasional), dan akademik, secara proporsional.
  • Topik: gabungan topik Kurikulum 2013 dan Kurikulum Merdeka, tanpa kosakata teknis yang terlalu jarang.
  • Bentuk teks tidak selalu paragraf: bisa e-mail, pengumuman, resep, infografis, atau artikel.
